content: TanStack Table v8 is the stable headless table library for React (v9 in beta as of mid-2026, not production-ready). ~14.6kB min+gzip, renders nothing itself — you own the markup, pairs naturally with Tailwind. Handles sorting/filtering/pagination state; for admin datasets in the thousands of rows, client-side pagination/filtering is fine, otherwise pair with server-side mode. Standard 2025-2026 choice for React admin data tables when not using a full component-library table (MUI DataGrid, AntD Table).
